Body.Content:
Power BI Desktop is now completely accessible for both report consumption and report creation. One of the most asked for features related to Q&A—support for live connect—is now available in preview. There are also a lot of smaller improvements across the product, such as customizable tooltips for buttons and a larger DAX formula bar.

For more information, see the Power BI blog.
